verdict.rationale: Polar is a billing and Merchant of Record platform. A buyer could fairly ask whether such a SaaS platform lets users schedule recurring automations, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only built-in recurring behaviour: subscriptions renew automatically each billing period, and failed payments are retried on a fixed dunning schedule. Nothing shows a user-defined way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows; webhooks and the MCP server are event-driven or on-demand, not scheduled.
